content: {"reasoning":"The retroactive authorization window is closed, and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review, so those pathways cannot progress the CO-197 denial. A formal appeal is available because a denial is on the table, and the strong clinic documentation can support medical necessity; this action also has the most established success among similar claims (9 paid). Resubmitting without addressing the authorization denial has not succeeded on similar claims, while patient billing is premature before the payer appeal path is exhausted.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
